role: own builder; auxiliary, not independent reviewer
authorization: Parent authorized only this own helper in a new isolated overlay; root owns wiring/tests, CI builder owns generic participation.
cause: W26 positive prepare/verify/output proof still complete the two Atlas observations and six BCS contexts, but repeated own witnesses and transaction boundaries consume the unchanged cumulative deadline.
design: Only UI lexical Memory observations with a completed exact case proof may attempt the optional readMemoryCanonical callback.
The external Memory fence retains full C08 state, three source snapshots, source fences, environment/principal digests and the existing Request/binding/selection identity.
An independent actual C08 atlas read derives the owner from the real authorized case projection and gathers complete refs from the case and entire matching partition.
Eligibility accepts only Procurement record leaves and case-event refs from this same case; the original recursive predicate is byte-exact. Unsupported before work keeps the canonical path.

Inside the qualified root, an actual atlas read compares the entire protected state and partition again before calling the actual canonical Atlas producer. Drift refuses without recapturing or retrying.

A private second ALS frame permits only the already-completed exact case/readDigest proof. Real cases C08 authority, full state/source hashes, environment, principal, Request/all headers, binding/lease and reader selection remain current.
Internal case reads return clones without the external sf-memory-case-fence hook tag. External before/after/final Memory witnesses remain outside the root.
The internal case reader claims before its first await. Reentry, overlap, foreign selector or detached closed frame refuses and invalidates the parent scope.
The callback must run once and the observation value must equal its actual returned value. Unsupported after entry, partial work, changed state or forged observed result cannot retry outside.
The frame closes in finally; pending internal readers invalidate it. The second Atlas observation constructs a new independent lexical scope.
